text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their ccuracy.
- Malta imports, exports rise in June. The Central Office of Statistics issued figures showing imports growth outstripping exports.
- Government reviewing its financial situation. Deficit projections said to have risen to between 120 million and 130 million Maltese liri. Minister says official figures will be published soon.
